title: fix(layout): list a collapsed nav group's entries in the sidebar icon rail
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x4eJGcaqqkdjBY8VWNya5Zg)_

Fixes #32156

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 侧栏收成图标栏(1360 px 这类笔记本宽度,或手动折叠成图标)时,声明 `expanded: false` 的分组(账户 → 开发者:API 密钥、OAuth 应用;设置 → 高级)现在也像展开的分组一样,把每个条目画成一枚图标。
- **为什么改:** 以前这些分组在图标栏里一个图标都没有,条目完全点不到,用户会以为 API 密钥这类功能不存在。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 `NavigationRenderer` 分组的渲染条件,分组自己的展开状态不动;宽屏展开侧栏和图标栏展开浮层里分组照旧是折叠的、带计数。回滚即 revert 这一个提交。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`(分组的 `Collapsible open` 一行与新的 `NavIconRailContext`),再看 `UnifiedSidebar.railOverlay-27593.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe。
- **两分钟验证:** 浏览器窗口调到 1360 px 打开 Console 的账户应用,图标栏里应出现 API 密钥和 OAuth 应用两枚图标,点击或 Tab+回车可进入;点栏背景展开浮层,开发者分组仍是折叠的并显示 2。
- **需要你做的:** 无,等席位复审后由席位落地。

## What changes

At rail width the console sidebar is the desktop sidebar collapsed to icons. There a group's label is hidden (`invisible`, no pointer events) and its entries are the rail's icons. A group declared `expanded: false` kept its entries behind a closed Radix `Collapsible`, which unmounts its content, so it contributed nothing to the rail at all.

`NavigationRenderer` (`@object-ui/layout`) now provides, at the tree root next to the existing phone-size answer, whether the desktop sidebar is collapsed to icons (`NavIconRailContext`: sidebar provider present, not mobile, `state === 'collapsed'`). A group renders its `Collapsible` open when it is open **or** the sidebar is in the icon rail. Its own `isOpen` state is untouched, so the expanded sidebar (the rail's overlay, a wide window) still shows the group collapsed, with its entry count, until the reader opens it, and a group opened there stays as the reader left it across folds.

**Which of the card's two options, and why:** the card offered (a) a group icon with a flyout, or (b) listing the group's entries regardless of `expanded`. An expanded group already renders in the rail as (b): its label hides and its entries are the rail's icons, each with its tooltip and accessible name; there is no group icon anywhere in the rail today. (b) makes a collapsed group render exactly as an expanded one does there, adds no new control, and gives each entry the same pointer, keyboard and tooltip path every other rail icon has.

Per the seat's ruling on the thread, this applies in every icon-collapsed sidebar: the narrow-window rail and a wide window collapsed to icons by hand (Cmd+B / the app bar trigger), where the same defect held. The wide-window *expanded* sidebar is unchanged.

The icon-rail answer changes on every toggle, and only the groups read it, so a toggle re-renders the groups (and the rows inside them), not the top-level rows; the phone drawer path (`isMobile`) is untouched.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing rail harness, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.railOverlay-27593.test.tsx` ("a collapsed group’s entries in the icon rail"), real `SidebarProvider` / `Sidebar` / `NavigationRenderer` / `useResponsiveSidebar`, navigation with a `Developer` group declared `expanded: false` holding `API Keys` and `OAuth Applications`:

- at 1360 px the rail lists both entries and a **click** on one navigates, rail stays folded;
- at 1360 px **Tab** from `Contacts` reaches `API Keys` (user-event) and **Enter** opens it;
- a 1440 px window collapsed to icons with the app bar trigger lists them too;
- preservation: the rail expanded over the content keeps the group's disclosure `aria-expanded="false"` with its count `2` and no entries, before and after a fold;
- preservation: at 1440 px the expanded sidebar keeps the group collapsed until a click on its disclosure opens it.

**Repro before / after** (same file, same tree except the renderer change):

- `origin/main` 8523ef9a with the new tests: `Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22)` — the first four above fail (`the collapsed group draws its entries in the rail: expected null not to be null`; Tab ends on the group's button, never on an entry); the 1440 px preservation pin passes on `main` as it should.
- this branch: `Tests 22 passed (22)`.

Wider local run: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/layout/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/` → `Test Files 189 passed (189)`, `Tests 1324 passed (1324)`, which includes the renderer's existing group pins (`groupDefaultOpen-13336`, `groupChildCount-25876`, `iconModeLabelHitTest-12744`, `listNesting-11690`, `phoneDrawerOpen-29141`) and the sidebar's `iconModeLabelFocus-12795` / `iconRailScroll-12794`.

The test DOM computes no Tailwind, so the group's hidden label is still a Tab stop there; the keyboard pin tabs on (a few presses at most) until it lands on the entry. In a browser the label is `invisible` in the rail (`HIDDEN_ICON_LABEL_NOT_FOCUSABLE`, unchanged).

## Acceptance notes

- Browser reading at 1360 px: NOT MEASURED in this thread (no running Console); the reachability claim rests on the real-input pins above.
- A `NavigationRenderer` used inside a sidebar whose `collapsible` is `offcanvas` would also mount a collapsed group's rows while that sidebar is collapsed (off-screen). The sidebar context does not expose the collapsible mode; the console sidebar is `collapsible="icon"`. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

Gate readings are in `/mnt/project-files/card-32156/gates-0d7eb111.txt` (project files of the seat's project): every command `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives for this diff, plus `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` and `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`, each as `cmd :: exit N`, and the two package type-checks.
